definition_used: One or more companies/institutions misunderstood one or more parts of a message sent to and/or from one or more companies/institutions.
caution: The definition describes a communication misunderstanding involving companies/institutions, but does not specify any impact on research content, authorship, editorial processes, or post-publication oversight. It is a status/notice about a procedural miscommunication, not a substantive manuscript integrity issue.
semantic_rationale: The definition refers to a misunderstanding in messages between companies/institutions, which is a general procedural issue without direct link to manuscript reliability, attribution, peer review, or post-publication processes. It is too ambiguous to assign any manuscript-facing category.
